title: Introduction to Modern C++
text:
C++ is a powerful, general-purpose programming language that supports multiple programming paradigms. 
It combines the efficiency of low-level languages with the abstraction capabilities of high-level languages. 

Modern C++ refers to C++11 and later standards, which introduced many features that make the language safer, more expressive, and easier to use. 
These features include auto type deduction, range-based for loops, smart pointers, lambda expressions, and more. 

The language continues to evolve with new standards like C++14, C++17, C++20, and C++23, each adding improvements and new capabilities.
textTranslate:
C++ 是一种强大的通用编程语言，支持多种编程范式。 
它结合了低级语言的效率和高级语言的抽象能力。 

现代 C++ 指的是 C++11 及以后的标准，引入了许多使语言更安全、更具表现力、更易用的特性。 
这些特性包括 auto 类型推导、基于范围的 for 循环、智能指针、lambda 表达式等。 

该语言继续发展，出现了 C++14、C++17、C++20 和 C++23 等新标准，每个标准都增加了改进和新功能。

title: The auto Keyword
text:
The auto keyword in C++11 allows the compiler to automatically deduce the type of a variable from its initializer. 
This reduces verbosity and makes code more maintainable. 

For example, instead of writing std::vector<int>::iterator it = vec.begin(), you can simply write auto it = vec.begin(). 
The compiler deduces that it is of type std::vector<int>::iterator. 

Auto follows the same type deduction rules as template type deduction. 
It strips away references and top-level const qualifiers, so auto x = 42 deduces int, not const int. 
To preserve const or reference, you can use const auto& or auto&&.
textTranslate:
C++11 中的 auto 关键字允许编译器从初始化器自动推导变量的类型。 
这减少了冗长性，使代码更易维护。 

例如，不必写 std::vector<int>::iterator it = vec.begin()，你可以简单地写 auto it = vec.begin()。 
编译器推导出 it 的类型是 std::vector<int>::iterator。 

Auto 遵循与模板类型推导相同的规则。 
它会去除引用和顶层 const 限定符，所以 auto x = 42 推导为 int，而不是 const int。 
要保留 const 或引用，可以使用 const auto& 或 auto&&。

title: Range-based For Loops
text:
Range-based for loops, introduced in C++11, provide a cleaner syntax for iterating over containers. 
Instead of manually managing iterators, you can iterate directly over the elements. 

The syntax is: for (declaration : range) { statements }. 
The range can be any container that provides begin() and end() iterators, or a C-style array. 

You can use auto to let the compiler deduce the element type, or specify it explicitly. 
To avoid copying, use const auto& for read-only access or auto& for modification. 
This makes code more readable and less error-prone than traditional iterator-based loops.
textTranslate:
C++11 引入的基于范围的 for 循环为遍历容器提供了更简洁的语法。 
不必手动管理迭代器，可以直接遍历元素。 

语法是：for (declaration : range) { statements }。 
范围可以是任何提供 begin() 和 end() 迭代器的容器，或 C 风格数组。 

可以使用 auto 让编译器推导元素类型，或显式指定。 
为避免复制，对只读访问使用 const auto&，对修改使用 auto&。 
这使代码比传统的基于迭代器的循环更易读且更不易出错。

title: Lambda Expressions
text:
Lambda expressions in C++11 provide a way to define anonymous functions inline. 
They are particularly useful with STL algorithms and for creating function objects on the fly. 

The basic syntax is: [capture](parameters) -> return_type { body }. 
The capture clause specifies which variables from the enclosing scope are accessible. 

You can capture by value [=], by reference [&], or selectively [x, &y]. 
Lambdas can be stored in variables using auto, or passed directly to functions. 
They are essentially syntactic sugar for function objects, but much more convenient to use.
textTranslate:
C++11 中的 lambda 表达式提供了一种内联定义匿名函数的方法。 
它们在与 STL 算法一起使用和即时创建函数对象时特别有用。 

基本语法是：[capture](parameters) -> return_type { body }。 
捕获子句指定可以从封闭作用域访问哪些变量。 

可以按值捕获 [=]，按引用捕获 [&]，或选择性捕获 [x, &y]。 
Lambda 可以使用 auto 存储在变量中，或直接传递给函数。 
它们本质上是函数对象的语法糖，但使用起来更方便。

title: Smart Pointers
text:
Smart pointers are RAII-compliant wrappers around raw pointers that automatically manage memory. 
They were introduced in C++11 to help prevent memory leaks and make memory management safer. 

There are three main types: std::unique_ptr, std::shared_ptr, and std::weak_ptr. 
unique_ptr represents exclusive ownership and cannot be copied, only moved. 
shared_ptr allows multiple pointers to share ownership of the same object. 
weak_ptr is a non-owning reference that doesn't affect the object's lifetime. 

Using smart pointers eliminates the need for manual new and delete, reducing the risk of memory leaks and dangling pointers.
textTranslate:
智能指针是围绕原始指针的符合 RAII 的包装器，可自动管理内存。 
它们在 C++11 中引入，以帮助防止内存泄漏并使内存管理更安全。 

主要有三种类型：std::unique_ptr、std::shared_ptr 和 std::weak_ptr。 
unique_ptr 表示独占所有权，不能复制，只能移动。 
shared_ptr 允许多个指针共享同一对象的所有权。 
weak_ptr 是非拥有引用，不影响对象的生命周期。 

使用智能指针消除了手动 new 和 delete 的需要，降低了内存泄漏和悬空指针的风险。

title: Move Semantics
text:
Move semantics, introduced in C++11, allows the efficient transfer of resources from one object to another. 
Instead of copying, which can be expensive, move semantics transfers ownership. 

An rvalue reference, denoted by &&, can bind to temporary objects. 
The move constructor and move assignment operator use rvalue references to efficiently transfer resources. 

std::move() converts an lvalue to an rvalue reference, enabling move semantics. 
After a move operation, the source object is left in a valid but unspecified state. 
Move semantics significantly improve performance by avoiding unnecessary copies of large objects.
textTranslate:
C++11 引入的移动语义允许高效地将资源从一个对象转移到另一个对象。 
不是复制（可能很昂贵），移动语义转移所有权。 

右值引用，用 && 表示，可以绑定到临时对象。 
移动构造函数和移动赋值运算符使用右值引用来高效地转移资源。 

std::move() 将左值转换为右值引用，启用移动语义。 
移动操作后，源对象处于有效但未指定的状态。 
移动语义通过避免不必要的大对象复制显著提高了性能。

title: Templates and Generic Programming
text:
Templates are C++'s mechanism for generic programming, allowing code to work with different types. 
A template is a blueprint for generating code at compile time. 

Function templates allow you to write a single function that works with multiple types. 
Class templates allow you to define classes that work with different types. 

Template specialization allows you to provide specific implementations for particular types. 
Variadic templates, introduced in C++11, allow templates to accept a variable number of arguments. 
Templates are powerful but can make code harder to read and debug, so use them judiciously.
textTranslate:
模板是 C++ 的泛型编程机制，允许代码与不同类型一起工作。 
模板是在编译时生成代码的蓝图。 

函数模板允许你编写一个适用于多种类型的函数。 
类模板允许你定义适用于不同类型的类。 

模板特化允许你为特定类型提供具体实现。 
C++11 引入的可变参数模板允许模板接受可变数量的参数。 
模板很强大，但可能使代码更难阅读和调试，因此要谨慎使用。

title: STL Containers and Algorithms
text:
The Standard Template Library (STL) provides a rich collection of containers, iterators, and algorithms. 
Containers store data, iterators provide access to elements, and algorithms operate on ranges. 

Common containers include vector, list, deque, map, set, and unordered_map. 
Each container has different performance characteristics and use cases. 

STL algorithms like std::sort, std::find, and std::transform work with iterators. 
They are generic and can work with any container that provides appropriate iterators. 
The separation of containers and algorithms through iterators is a key design principle of the STL.
textTranslate:
标准模板库（STL）提供了丰富的容器、迭代器和算法集合。 
容器存储数据，迭代器提供对元素的访问，算法对范围进行操作。 

常见容器包括 vector、list、deque、map、set 和 unordered_map。 
每个容器都有不同的性能特征和用例。 

像 std::sort、std::find 和 std::transform 这样的 STL 算法与迭代器一起工作。 
它们是泛型的，可以与任何提供适当迭代器的容器一起工作。 
通过迭代器分离容器和算法是 STL 的关键设计原则。

title: RAII and Resource Management
text:
RAII stands for Resource Acquisition Is Initialization, a fundamental C++ idiom. 
It ensures that resources are properly managed by tying their lifetime to object lifetime. 

When an object is created, it acquires resources. 
When the object is destroyed, it automatically releases those resources. 

This applies to any resource: memory, file handles, locks, network connections, etc. 
Smart pointers are a perfect example of RAII for memory management. 
RAII eliminates the need for manual resource management and makes code exception-safe. 
It's one of the most important principles in modern C++ programming.
textTranslate:
RAII 代表资源获取即初始化，是 C++ 的基本惯用法。 
它通过将资源生命周期与对象生命周期绑定来确保资源得到正确管理。 

创建对象时，它获取资源。 
销毁对象时，它自动释放这些资源。 

这适用于任何资源：内存、文件句柄、锁、网络连接等。 
智能指针是内存管理 RAII 的完美示例。 
RAII 消除了手动资源管理的需要，并使代码异常安全。 
它是现代 C++ 编程中最重要的原则之一。

title: Exception Handling
text:
Exception handling in C++ provides a mechanism for dealing with error conditions. 
It allows you to separate error handling code from normal program flow. 

The try block contains code that might throw exceptions. 
The catch block handles specific types of exceptions. 
You can have multiple catch blocks for different exception types. 

Functions that might throw exceptions should be marked with noexcept(false) or not marked at all. 
Functions guaranteed not to throw should be marked noexcept. 
Exception safety is important: operations should maintain invariants even when exceptions occur. 
The three levels of exception safety are: basic guarantee, strong guarantee, and no-throw guarantee.
textTranslate:
C++ 中的异常处理提供了处理错误条件的机制。 
它允许你将错误处理代码与正常程序流程分离。 

try 块包含可能抛出异常的代码。 
catch 块处理特定类型的异常。 
可以为不同的异常类型设置多个 catch 块。 

可能抛出异常的函数应标记为 noexcept(false) 或根本不标记。 
保证不抛出的函数应标记为 noexcept。 
异常安全很重要：即使发生异常，操作也应保持不变量。 
异常安全的三个级别是：基本保证、强保证和无抛出保证。
